extra: This release will be the first beta release. It's still in development, but it's the first release that we consider to be stable enough for daily use. You can start using it as your main browser right now if you are reading this!
features: Other minor UI additions and improvements
Added support for an automatic update system

fixes.description: Fixed a bug where the browser would crash when opening any extension
Fixed extension icon resolution on the toolbar
Applied a fix for that affected some Linux users
